t: ff.109 A family doctor called AI
st: What if artificial intelligence takes care of us?

sec.p: Arianna Huffington (founder of the newspaper that bears her name) is the woman with the most followers on LinkedIn.

sec.t: ff.109.2 From media to digital wellbeing
sec.p: So she launched Thrive Global, to channel the power of algorithms with one priority: human psychophysical wellbeing.

sec.t: ff.109.3 Untangling a ball of yarn in a minute
sec.p: Ariadne's thread. Let's look at an example of how Thrive uses AI to get out of the labyrinth of an algorithmic society. In one minute.
And if I share with you my story would you share your dollar with me? Aloe Blacc, I Need A Dollar
